outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: Fossils of Parasaurolophus have been found across North America and a complete skeleton was found in Canada.

outgoing.name: Cretaceous
outgoing.excerpt: Parasaurolophus was a genus of hadrosaurid (duck-billed) dinosaur from the Upper Cretaceous Period (about 76-65 million years ago) of what is now North America.
